property: No two replicas apply different commands at the same committed index; at most one elected leader may have valid election authority in a term.
method: Compare independent committed/apply witnesses at matching indices and vote/election evidence; distinguish a candidate's belief from quorum-certified election. Client histories supplement the internal witness.
witness_requirements: Term/role observation with task/thread identity, asynchronous incoming heartbeat, overlapping main protocol operation, emitted log identity/value, commit quorums and conflicting applied values.
